ma.setCustomEvent(Object object)

Register a custom event for your mini-program to trigger callbacks in specified scenarios (minimum version: 25.12.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
eventName String Yes Custom event name (the event name cannot be an empty string)
callback Function Yes Custom event callback functions can be used to meet the callback scenario and trigger multiple times.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String setCustomEvent: ok

Sample Code

ma.setCustomEvent({
  eventName: 'lockScreen',
  callback: () => {
    ma.showModal({
      content: 'lockScreen',
      title: 'callback',
      success: (res) => {},
      fail: (res) => {},
      complete: (res) => {},
    });
  },
  success: (res) => {
    console.log(res, 'success');
  },
  fail: (err) => {
    console.log(err, 'fail');
  },
  complete: (res) => {
    console.log(res, 'complete');
  },
});

Usage Restrictions

  1. Custom events require the host side to design the event scenario and event name.
  2. Only one callback function can be registered for the same event name. Multiple duplicate callbacks will use the callback passed in during the last registration.

Tips

  1. Please note that setting too many listener events will increase memory consumption. Please set the number of listener events reasonably.
  2. Custom events cannot override existing basic events in the mini-program, such as onAppShow.
